title: Concept: Tax residency status exposed
description: A FATCA or CRS status field on a customer record in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The status says which country the bank reports the account to, which is a tax and nationality signal that the customer's own app does not need and an attacker can use for a pretext.
applicability: Deployments that render a FATCA or CRS status field on a customer record into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The status says which country the bank reports the account to, which is a tax and nationality signal that the customer's own app does not need and an attacker can use for a pretext.
